literal_source_claim_en: The maximum transmission rate of a channel.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies a noun and maximum-rate gloss but does not select a definition or theorem. Shannon 1948 separately gives a noiseless asymptotic definition, a finite-state determinant theorem, a noisy discrete maximum-information-rate definition, an operational limit theorem, and a continuous-channel definition. It fixes none of the channel class, rate/error semantics, maximum versus supremum, limit hypotheses, normalization, ordered binders, or boundary cases. Selecting a familiar capacity formula would invent, narrow, or substitute mathematics.

conclusion: Open: the repository does not state whether the conclusion is a capacity definition, existence of a limit or maximum, a finite-state determinant formula, an operational equality, a capacity-achieving input result, or a continuous-channel characterization.
